step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts Pinterest's token vending solution to grant granular, secure data access to Hadoop/Presto/Spark clusters running on Amazon EC2. The visual nodes drawn include the internal developers/users, EC2 instances, a custom Token Vending service, an LDAP directory, AWS STS, two IAM Managed Policies (MP1 and MP2), and two Amazon S3 buckets. The arrows map the sequence from user authentication via Kerberos, calling the Token Vending service, fetching group mapping from LDAP, generating session tokens with restricted policies from AWS STS, and using these tokens to directly query the S3 buckets.

graph.name: Pinterest: Dynamic S3 Data Access Control using AWS STS
graph.notes: Whiteboard diagram illustrating Pinterest's architecture for secure, dynamic, and scalable data access to S3 buckets using AWS STS and session policies mapped via LDAP.
